title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: intelligent summaries of Copilot adoption trends
summary: Hold: the feature-access policy route omits the app and feature selections needed to reach the correct setting. The eligibility checklist also counts licences held rather than assigned licences, which could lead administrators to expect summaries in an ineligible tenant. The rollout, default state and included licensing model are supported.

claims.claim: The web app policy route is Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting > On or Off.
claims.quote: 3. Select Create a policy. 4. Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy. 5. Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off to enable or disable the feature.
claims.fix: Set controls[0].ui.path and the rendered table path to 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app > feature > Access setting > On or Off'. Keep the note choosing Viva Insights web app. The app and feature selections determine which control is configured and cannot be omitted as wizard text fields. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide web app disable policy.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone
